context: The Sets view reads identified cards only. A fresh capture of the same card does not count until it is identified, so a card can show Last copy while a second copy waits to be identified.

options.gain: No change; a count is never a guess.
options.label: Identified only
options.lose: Last copy can show while a second copy waits.

options.how: Count unidentified captures where the store already holds a SKU for them.
options.label: Count captured too
options.lose: Most captures have no SKU yet, so it rarely helps, and it adds a rule.

title: Should Last copy count new captures that are not identified yet?
why: An unidentified capture has no name to match on, so counting it would be a guess.
